provenance: All XML, date values and unknown properties in these tests are independently authored. No camera media, identifying metadata or upstream fixture bytes are included.

actualRun.platform: Windows x86_64; tests consume authored bytes in memory
actualRun.countingRule: Counts include each explicit prepare call and each completed loop iteration in this one test target. This record is a finite observed summary, not a generated local test log.

derivativeAssertions: Actual candidate bytes contain the intended mapped text at the returned derivative span.
Candidate prefix before the span and suffix after the span equal the original bytes exactly, including length-changing date values.
Candidate bytes reparse through the bounded XMP model; other properties retain exact model identities and values.
Unknown namespace/sibling bytes, namespace declarations, attribute quotes, CRLF, comments, processing instructions, list order and CDATA outside the selected span remain unchanged.
Identical date strings in unrelated attributes, unknown namespaces, comments and siblings do not become the selected target.
noOpAssertions: The entire result equals the original byte slice and uses the same borrowed pointer.
No changed span is reported, including entity spellings, CDATA, comment-split date text and quoted attributes.
refusalFamilies: Non-plain target lexical representations for replacement: numeric entities, CDATA, comment/processing-instruction splits and attribute entities.
Missing, duplicate, list-valued and wrong/stale ordinal targets.
Malformed XML, DTD and non-UTF-8 bytes.
Input above 65536 bytes and a 65530-byte input whose larger derivative exceeds 65536 bytes.

limits.qualifiedScope: One in-memory existing simple-date replacement under the exact #0083 mapping and #0081 parser subset.
limits.otherPlatforms: This record claims the actual Windows run only; independent CI may add platform observations.

sourceBindings.canonicalization: UTF-8 source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF, matching Git text attributes. qualification.json is excluded to avoid self-reference.
